dynamicViews.description: How one outbound FedNow payment travels through the Clearing Platform end to end.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Clearing Platform

relationships.description: 1. Submits outbound payment request
2. Routes request after token validation
3. Checks idempotency key; saves payment + work item atomically
4. Picks up work item
5. Requests ISO 20022 pacs.008 message
6. Screens payment (blocks if unavailable)
7. Reserves funds (hold)
8. Sends pacs.008 to FedNow simulator
9. Returns pacs.002 confirmation
10. Delivers confirmation
11. Records confirmation
12. Picks up confirmation work item
13. Posts final settlement entries (converts hold to debit)
14. Notifies credit union core of confirmed result

dynamicViews.description: How funds are held, then posted, for one outbound payment.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Settlement Platform

relationships.description: 1. Requests hold (reserve) for payment amount
2. Checks available funds; creates hold entry atomically
3. On network confirmation, requests post
4. Converts hold into permanent debit; writes outbox event
5. Reads new outbox entry (stretch)
6. Publishes balance-changed event (stretch)

dynamicViews.description: How the Post-Settlement Platform reconciles numbers after the daily cut-off.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Post-Settlement Platform

relationships.description: 1. Writes end-of-day cut-off marker
2. Downloads payment records as of cut-off
3. Downloads ledger entries as of cut-off
4. Downloads FedNow statement via FedLine API
5. Downloads RTP settlement report via SFTP
6. Stores normalized data
7. Stores originals untouched
8. Compares platform vs ledger vs network statements; writes breaks

dynamicViews.description: How an inbound FedNow credit is received and credited to the member's account.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Clearing Platform

relationships.description: 1. Delivers inbound pacs.008 credit
2. Routes inbound credit
3. Checks idempotency; saves inbound payment + work item
4. Picks up inbound work item
5. Parses ISO 20022 pacs.008
6. Posts credit to receiving credit union's account
7. Notifies credit union core to credit member's account

dynamicViews.description: What happens when a Payment Worker crashes mid-flight on a work item.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Clearing Platform

relationships.description: 1. Picks up work item; lease expires on crash
2. On restart, picks up same item (lease reacquired)
3. Retries reserve — ledgerService ignores duplicate (idempotency key)
4. Retries send — network sees duplicate; returns original answer
5. Max retries exceeded — moves item to dead-letter table
6. Ops staff investigates dead-letter entry

dynamicViews.description: How a two-person correction is proposed, approved, and applied to the ledger.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Post-Settlement Platform

relationships.description: 1. Investigates break; proposes correcting entry
2. Submits proposed correction
3. Saves correction in pending state
4. Reviews and approves correction (must be different person)
5. Submits approval with approver identity
6. Records approval
7. Sends correcting entry with approver identity in payload
8. Posts idempotent correcting entry; records approver identity
